source: Seven user-supplied ICT4F/T4F 369 Levels screenshots; eighth slide not provided
missing_from_source: rounding of decimal anchor before digit reduction

research_assumptions.anchor: strict 3-left/3-right confirmed swing; known only at close of third right bar; most recent per side
research_assumptions.grid: 4 inward levels from high downward or low upward; preserve original fractional price; floor positive anchor for root
research_assumptions.touch_tolerance: 0.05 times ATR14 from preceding closed bar
research_assumptions.approach_side: BUY reaction if preceding close above level+tol; SELL if below level-tol
research_assumptions.rejection: touch bar closes >=0.10 prior ATR away in reaction direction and directional body >=0.25 prior ATR
research_assumptions.ambiguous_multi_level_touch: exclude from executable entry analysis; retain descriptive counts
research_assumptions.execution_proxy: next bar open; one position; fixed 1 prior ATR midpoint stop, 1.5R midpoint target, 12-bar max hold; gap exits conservative; stop-first intrabar ambiguity
research_assumptions.risk_unit: 25 USD per 1R; fractional research units, no claim of PU Prime lot admissibility
research_assumptions.cost_comparison: identical midpoint trade ledger; adverse half-spread and slip on both executions; commission each side; quote-trigger sensitivity not native tested

controls: last four confirmed structural pivot levels
evaluation: counts of causal anchors and touched levels
gross and net R, net USD, PF, drawdown, win rate
mean outcome and costs per campaign
early and late chronological subperiods without parameter selection
